text:
Rhea: DeployBot flagged a mismatch: some nodes serving runtime 3.0.1 while rollout target is 3.1.0-beta. Suggested pin to avoid SDK serialization mismatch.
DeployBot: [automated] ALERT: sdk_runtime_mismatch (cohort: ml-ingest-canary). Suggested action: pin SDK to 3.0.1 for affected cohort. Logs: /deploybot/2999900000.
Carlos: which nodes?
Amir: nodes: [ingest-us-central-4, ingest-us-central-9]. Error: payload_deserialize_error when model returns structured-toolcall.
Rhea: options: pin SDK on those hosts, or route them to runtime 3.0.1. I prefer narrow SDK pin so runtime stays consistent for most hosts.
Carlos: agree. Run TTL=2h and flip telemetry.
DeployBot: SUGGEST: deployctl sdk pin --cohort=ml-ingest-canary --sdk-version=3.0.1 --instances=ingest-us-central-4,ingest-us-central-9 --ttl=7200
Amir: executing now. Cmd ran and returned: applied. run id sb-2999900000-01.
QA-Bot: quick smoke: toolcall serialization tests (20 runs) -> 19/20 pass, failure on ingest-us-central-9. Attaching trace id 0xA3F.
Rhea: create release-note internal blurb and notify CS. If failures >1% in 30m, prepare rollback of the canary.
Carlos: rollback plan noted: deployctl rollback --canary=ml-ingest-canary; incident channel ready.
Rhea: decision: apply SDK pin-bridge, monitor 30m, escalate if errors spike. Closing for now.
DeployBot: [automated] TELEMETRY_FLAG set: sdk_deser_watch=true for sb-2999900000-01. Alerts configured.
